title: Live Today at 6:00 PM: Dhwani TTS Launch & Q&A!
short_msg: Join our special YouTube Live today at 6:00 PM for the official Dhwani TTS launch, live testing, and Q&A! Double tap for details.
full_msg:
Warm greetings from Interested Technology for Blind!

We are super excited to invite you to a special Live Event today at 6:00 PM IST!

What we will cover in today's live session:
1. Official Launch & complete overview of Dhwani Text-to-Speech Engine.
2. Detailed discussion on features, Indian voices, and real-time live testing.
3. Live Q&A Session: Ask your questions, share suggestions, and interact directly with us!

Tap the 'Open Link' button below to visit our official YouTube channel right now. Please make sure to Subscribe and turn on the notification bell so you get notified as soon as we go live at 6:00 PM!

See you all in the live stream!
update_notes: Version 1.7.1 fixes the 0% update download bug and includes fast Indian voices with HD clarity. Update now!
